```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Bill of Rights lists religious liberty, with its rights of conscience, as the first freedom to be protected.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Religious freedom in the Bill of Rights protects the right of the people to practice their faith in their everyday lives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"George Washington taught that religion and morality are indispensable supports to a free society.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Thomas Jefferson declared that no provision in the Constitution ought to be dearer to man than that which protects the rights of conscience against the enterprises of the civil authority.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ongoing attempts to compel individuals, businesses, and institutions of faith to transgress their beliefs are part of a misguided effort to undermine religion and drive it from the public square.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many charitable religious institutions that have demonstrated great success in helping the needy have been barred from receiving government grants and contracts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Government officials threaten religious colleges and universities with massive fines and seek to control their personnel decisions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Places of worship for the first time in history have reason to fear the loss of tax-exempt status merely for espousing and practicing traditional religious beliefs that have been held across the world for thousands of years, and for almost four centuries in America.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The source values the right of America's religious leaders to preach, and Americans to speak freely, according to their faith.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
